about: LFM3-VL-2B (MLX · 8-bit, Liquid AI's own export) on mlx-vlm 0.7.12's server at a 128,000-token window, two concurrent requests, thinking on by default. Vision and text share the same server: the image tower is loaded from the same directory and images go in through the OpenAI content-parts shape. Same host program as the 8-bit text launch — mlx-lm cannot load the LFM3 family yet (ml-explore/mlx-lm#2016), prefill runs in 128-token steps because mlx-vlm's default 2,048 made macOS abort prompts of 32K and more (kIOGPUCommandBufferCallbackErrorImpactingInteractivity), and MLX_VLM_TOKEN_QUEUE_TIMEOUT is raised because a prompt that fills the window outlives the 600 s default. 8-bit rather than 4-bit keeps the quality lossless, matching every other Apple-hosted recipe in this registry. Two sequences rather than one because a recipe on a setup over 8 GB must hold at least 131,072 KV tokens; this model's window is 128,000, so capacity comes from seqs (128,000 x 2 + 2,048 = 258,048) rather than from a context it was never trained for.
install: python3 -m pip install mlx-vlm==0.7.12 mlx==0.32.4 transformers==5.22.2 huggingface_hub==2.4.0 (macOS on Apple silicon, Python >= 3.10)
